decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1) The conversion of a single-family house into two self contained flats, would result in the loss of a family house for which there is an identified need in the Borough. The proposal would not provide satisfactory living accommodation for future residents, contrary to Council Supplementary Planning Guidance.  For these reasons, the proposal is contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines).

2) The proposal provides insufficient on-site parking, contrary to Council car parking standards, which would generate additional on street parking harmful to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians on the adjoining highway in light of highway conditions in the vicinity.
description: Conversion of existing house into 2- one bedroom self-contained flats incorporating alteration to rear of house.
